params.body:
The site's half of "the offer is a setting": every plan fact now comes from the Observatory through the projection.

**`App\Plans\Offer`** holds the projected offer (`/internal/projection/plans`, pulled by `reconcile:projection` and by the `plans` webhook nudge) with the code defaults as the fallback, field by field, so a projection that has not arrived yet leaves the site with the offer it had, never with none. An ability the site does not know is dropped; the latest is every plan's.

**`Plan`** reads label, price, blurb, abilities, archive window, reads per day and requests per minute through it. Price prints "Free", "EUR 14.99" or "EUR 1,499". A plan that is "by conversation" shows "Talk to the team" on the pricing page instead of a checkout; that used to be hardcoded to Intelligence. The agent rate limiter reads per-minute from the plan. The `plans` block in `config/gentells.php` is gone.

The cache lives in the container, not in a static: a static survived from one test to the next and made a Signal that opened reports in one test open them in every test after.

Suite 258 green, Pint clean. README and the design doc say where the offer lives now.
params.title: The offer comes from the Observatory through the projection
